codeName: your name to be used in the code. only overlap if you want to split the files into multiple different locations.
name: what you call yourself
displayName: the name to display on the woundview screen
personality: personality type. 'template' to NEVER pull from a personality, blank to randomize.
ABOUTCOLOURS: colours are in RGB format, from 0-255.
woundviewFirmwareText: For whatever reason, this is the 'v2.0' + ownerVersion part of the text. I don't think it's used, but I'm not sure.
woundviewVersionText: in case you want even more control. usually this is 'UNI-HEALTH v2.0' + ownerVersion!
endStatsID: the text that can replace the 'id' portion of the death screen
DELETEME: the above are offsets, meaning theyll be added or subtracted from whatever starting value exists

cutsceneTexts.endscreenstatus: any of the text that begins with 'endscreen' can be used here!
cutsceneTexts.biopodnotealt: restrained for causing damage to brain, WITHOUT hurting anyone. difficult- but possible!- to do.

items.itemdsc: these do nothing yet, but will in the future.

moodles.still trying to upkeep these!: ideally, you could copy the vanilla moodles, edit the second fields, and it will update itself.

seeGravel: youve just landed on the planet for the first time! what are your thoughts?
to note, if pause quotes are set to 'thoughts' and not enough dialogue is present,
thoughts will ALSO pull from this pool (in addition to 'trader_depressedresponse')
eatGood: despite the name of this dialogue, it also is used for drinks.
eatMediocre: too much of it is likely to make you queezy, but may not have lasting effects.
refuseEat: someone suggested trying to eat shit or magma.
its a stupid idea that nobody should try.
tired: youre a little sleepy. could use a lie-down.
verytired: you are actively falling asleep while standing up.
exhaustion is setting in, and you may just collapse if you arent careful.
confused: the world grows foggy and far away. something might be wrong, but you cant tell for sure.
wakeup: youve just woken up! youre still groggy.
'confused' lines often come after this one if you havent slept well.
sick: queezy, feeling bloated. maybe you ate something, or maybe you saw one too many dead bodies.
verysick: in a world of hurt. your stomach hurts, you may throw up, and youre exhausted easier.
feels pretty similar to getting stabbed.
vomit: you just threw up. this is generally not recommended to do.
vomitblood: blood has ejected from your body through your mouth.
full: youve eaten more than enough food to sate you.
a little uncomfortable, but not awful.
unless you throw up, i guess.
hungry: you need a snack. probably a little grumpy and emotional.
starving: shaking uncontrollably with hunger. your gut burns as it tries to eat itself
thirsty: your mouth is dry. probably a little dazed and slow.
dehydrated: your body is SUPPOSED to be mostly water. it probably isnt anymore
limbmuscle: the muscles in your limb have seriously deteriorated.
can use <limb> to reference the name of the limb
limbinfected: bacteria is attempting to consume your body.
it feels as if its been set on fire.
limbskin: your skin is damaged, revealing the flesh beneath.
sad: feeling a bit down, but nothing too serious
gloomy: its like the joy has been sucked out of the air
something is wrong, but you cant figure out a good angle to grapple with all this
depressed: starting to consider death as an alternative.
its like someone replaced you with a monster that wears your face
miserable: nothing is worth this. this is the limit of your sanity
selfharm-regulated: for when self-harm brings you back to a neutral-positive mood.
generally used for the selfdestructive trait
selfharm: for when self-harming while upset, and remaining upset
angeronitem: beating the shit out of a plush toy
what did they ever do to you
seecorpse: for the first few times a corpse is seen.
breakcorpse: breaking a corpse, which lowers happiness quite a bit.
breakcorpse-cannibalistic: for those who have no qualms with eating the flesh of their own kind.
not everyone thinks of cannibalism as tabboo- its up to you if they do or not!
braindamaged: something happened, and now you cant form thoughts or words quite like before.
when writing this dialogue, please do keep in mind: this is an injury, and a terrifying one at that.
you KNOW you arent operating correctly, but you cant think clearly enough to do much.
you are having seizures, flashes of fear, hearing things that arent there... ect.
this is a relatively common thing to have happen for some disabilities, so remain respectful!
lastmoments: you still may not die- but something has gone horribly wrong, regardless.
magicheal: a crystal has caused you to recover. the freak.
selfdestruct: something inside your body has started to beep.
wwmr: wwmr, aka: where we must reach.
you actually made it! so few do...
youre at the planets mantle. youre so close to the cargo, you can start to feel its pulse.
cargo1: youve found what youre here for. you actually, genuinely made it. this is your destination.
cargo2: for one, its not a battery, but also... it kinda looks like its about to explode?
cargoimpale: that was kinda rude, after all.
cargoimpale2: honestly, youre in a shockingly little amount of pain.
you really shouldnt go trying to touch it though.
the cargo seems to have given you strength. how strange is that?
cargoimpale3: youre pretty sure the pod above is working now.
or something. im not your mom
endlessloop0: you had the cargo in front of you, but now youre back here. somethings a little fishy.
endlessloop3: FOR REAL BRO A FOURTH TIME?
endpodexamine: examining the pod prior to actually being able to use it.
whys it suck tho. like whats wrong with it
ascententer: the pod has been pushed past its limits and wont bring you farther.
labenter: you step into a place you know very, very well.
labresponse: this is one of the ones who was abusing you and yours.
labthink1: youve been asked if you have any questions.
this hadnt been part of their plan.
labthink2chip: you cannot escape. your own mind wont allow it.
traderdepressed: pretty sure this dialogue is never called.
if i recall correctly, it WAS once used for hollow characters...? unsure.
